## Outcome

Describe the user-visible result and why it is needed.

## Contract and risk review

- [ ] Public schema/type/controller/guide changes stay synchronized.
- [ ] Security and permission boundaries were reviewed.
- [ ] Persistence, replay, undo/redo, and migration impact were reviewed.
- [ ] UI changes include screenshots or a short recording when useful.
- [ ] No secrets, live capabilities, or private data are included.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run demo:typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm test -- --run --maxWorkers=2`

List any additional smoke tests or manual checks performed.
